_about: Hand-written review of each mismatch scripts/verify_bulbapedia.py reports, checked against pret/pokefirered where the two sources disagree.

mismatches.vermilion-city: Vs. Seeker was missing: its script is in data/event_scripts.s, which the map pass didn't read. Added.
mismatches.safari-zone: Safari Balls are loaned for the game, not a pickup. OK.
mismatches.kindle-road: HM06 is given inside Ember Spa, which the app lists as its own place. OK.
mismatches.two-island: Bulbapedia lists Cape Brink's hidden items under Two Island; the app has them on Cape Brink. OK.
mismatches.resort-gorgeous: Selphy's rewards are random prizes, not fixed items. Not tracked.
mismatches.trainer-tower: Mode-clear prizes; not tracked as items.

order.underground-path-east-west: Either way works: the path joins Routes 7 and 8.
order.pokemon-tower: Bulbapedia mentions the tower on your first pass through Lavender; you can only climb it with the Silph Scope from the Rocket Hideout, as the app orders it.
order.route-16: Routes 12-15 and Cycling Road (16-18) both reach Fuchsia; either order works.
order.route-19: Power Plant is optional and can wait.

not_covered: Bulbapedia's FRLG Part 21 (event islands) doesn't exist, so Navel Rock and Birth Island stay Draft. Pokémon League steps are covered by Bulbapedia's Indigo Plateau section; Roaming by the Kanto post-game part.
corrections: Vs. Seeker gift in the Vermilion Pokémon Center added (shared script data/event_scripts.s).
Route 18: the Lickitung trade is with a boy upstairs in the gate.
Water Path: the Heracross size check is a woman in the northern house.
Power Plant: the fake item balls are Electrode.
